correctness.rationale: Exact resistance-distance identity gives max_v (L†)vv=(sum_i r_i+(m²−1)max_i r_i)/(m+1)² with r_i=1/w_i. For each dual probability p, Cauchy–Schwarz yields the global lower bound [sum sqrt(c_i(1+(m²−1)p_i))]²/[(m+1)²B]. Strict-concavity KKT forces p_i=(c_i/tau−1)_+/(m²−1), unique tau, and equality is attained by r_i=(Z/B)min(1,sqrt(c_i/tau)). Equality and budget saturation prove uniqueness. Dual KKT also gives iff uniformity threshold. A second admissible dual p_i=c_i/C proves the sharp upper ratio, with limit c_1 fixed and others→0. Standalone program verifies exact rational five-node inverse and 96 randomized full-matrix cases; it is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Worst-vertex stationary disagreement variance is a motivated fairness/robustness metric distinct from average coherence, spectral gap and max pair resistance. Exact closed-form minimax design for every star order and every strictly positive price vector, unique multilevel optimizer, sharp active-price criterion for equal weights and globally sharp dimension-dependent improvement ratio are meaningful complete structural classifications. Matrix identity and two-active-price exact rational instance substantiate nontrivial design geometry.
